# Kitchen Control

> Kitchen Control is UK back-of-house management software for independent restaurants, cafes and food businesses — allergen management, recipe costing, and AI invoice/label scanning, plus menu and dish building. Built by a working head chef in Mevagissey, Cornwall. From £12.99/month, 30-day free trial (card required at signup).

Kitchen Control helps single-site, independent hospitality businesses stay compliant with UK allergen law (the Food Information Regulations 2014), cost recipes and dishes accurately (with live GP% tracking), and cut kitchen admin time by scanning supplier invoices and ingredient labels with a phone camera. It also supports importing existing recipes (photographed, or as PDF/Word/Excel/text files) which are automatically parsed into structured, costed recipes. It is priced and built for independent kitchens and small groups, not large restaurant chains or enterprise hospitality groups.
